questions.question: Choose the correct form of the verb in brackets to complete the sentence: She said that she _____ to the cinema the previous evening.
Select the option that correctly reports the following statement: 'I have just finished my homework,' he said.
options: He said that he had just finished his homework.
He said that he has just finished his homework.
He said that he was just finishing his homework.
He said that he would finish his homework.
questions.answer: He said that he had just finished his homework.

questions.question: Identify the correct reported speech form: 'If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended it,' she remarked.
options: She said that if she had known about the meeting, she would have attended it.
She said that if she knew about the meeting, she would have attended it.
She said that if she had known about the meeting, she would attend it.
She said that if she knew about the meeting, she would attend it.
questions.answer: She said that if she had known about the meeting, she would have attended it.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the passive voice to report the information? The director announced that the film _____ for release next month.
Choose the appropriate collocation: 'The company is facing a lot of _____ from competitors.'
Select the correct dependent preposition: 'The issue is _____ the lack of communication between departments.'
Identify the correct form to complete the sentence: If we _____ the weather forecast, we wouldn't have gone hiking yesterday.
Which option correctly uses a discourse marker to begin a sentence? _____, I think we need to reconsider our strategy.
Choose the best word to complete the phrase: 'It's important to maintain a good _____ with your colleagues.'
Select the correct form of the conditional sentence: 'If I _____ more time, I would travel around the world.'
